_meta.purpose: Hand-curated thematic / expository questions for the v3 `thematic_qa` category — the gap protocol-v3 exposed (open-ended 'what does the Bible teach about X', 'who is Y', 'explain Z'). At build time each question is run through the live RAG retriever (rag/retrieval.py) for its Context block, then through the teacher (training/distill_answers.py) for a synthesized, cited answer. Probabilistic real-user framing prefixes + light paraphrase augmentation expand this core set toward ~2,500 training examples.
_meta.expansion: target ~10-15x via _persona() framing prefixes already in build_dataset_v2.py + 2-3 paraphrases per stem; keep the answer grounded in freshly-retrieved context each time
